facts.event: Tilde 的母亲在晚宴上把 Tilde 卖给了 warlord（Liran）。
facts.relation: Rivani 是 Tilde 的母亲、Merogia 的女王
facts.anchor: My mother sold me to the warlord at dinner.

facts.event: Isabella 死后不到两周 Liran 的求婚使者就到了，Tilde 让母亲 Rivani 接受条件。
facts.relation: Liran 是北方 Cynghal 的 swan king；Isabella 是他刚死于难产的王后
facts.anchor: when his proposals arrived within a fortnight of Isabella’s death, I told my mother, King Rivani, to accept them.

facts.event: 使节 Gundobar 当众说 Tilde 只是“一个子宫”，Merogia 还有很多可选的姑娘。
facts.relation: Gundobar 是 Liran 派来的 Cynghal 使节，Galen 出身、并非王子
facts.anchor: ‘She is but one womb,’ the emissary continued, ‘in a crop of many.’

facts.event: Rivani 反问 Gundobar：九岁的 Maela of Hallion 更合适吗？她还不能生育。
facts.relation: Maela of Hallion 是 Rivani 举出的另一个 Merogia 候选新娘
facts.anchor: ‘Maela of Hallion, perhaps? She is nine years of age, and cannot bear children till she has her bloods.’

facts.event: Rivani 提起 Gevera 六年前背叛 kith 之律，Tilde 由此想起死去亲人 Sanafin 的手在她掌中变冷。
facts.relation: Sanafin 是 Tilde 已死的亲人（回忆中她握着其变冷的手）
facts.anchor: They turned on their own six years ago.

facts.event: 验贞 priest 用手指检查 Tilde，Tilde 一脚把他的牙踢碎在脸上；Marolyn 趁机把毒草 nightwort 塞进他手里栽赃。
facts.relation: Marolyn 是 Tilde 的表亲（cousin），Hadiah 也是
facts.anchor: I had broken his teeth into his face with the sole of my foot.

facts.event: Gundobar 最终让步，答应 Rivani 的条件，婚事谈成。
facts.relation: Gundobar 代表 Liran 与 Rivani 谈判
facts.anchor: ‘We will agree to your terms,’ he said at last.

facts.event: Tilde 下定决心：不再有失败的叛乱，无论如何都要杀掉国王 Liran。
facts.anchor: No more failed rebellions. One way, or another, I would kill the king.
